content.value_statement: Many Shorts lose viewers before the first payoff and fail to send traffic to long-form videos. This skill helps write, diagnose, and refine Shorts using VVSA, retention, funnel, and monetization checks.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 30 to 45 second Shorts scripts with hook, escalation, payoff, CTA, and loop beats.
Diagnoses weak Shorts using VVSA, average percentage viewed, and retention curve shapes.
Builds long-form bridges with in-video callouts, pinned comments, final-frame labels, and channel context checks.
Checks platform issues such as aspect ratio, safe-zone captions, watermarks, and first-frame quality.
Explains Shorts monetization choices, including Engaged Views, licensed music splits, and YPP eligibility paths.
limitations: Does not access YouTube Studio data unless the user provides metrics.
Cannot guarantee virality, reach, RPM, or eligibility outcomes.
Uses general strategy patterns, not live niche-specific performance datasets.
Does not create video files, thumbnails, captions, or uploaded assets by itself.

use_cases.title: Script a New Short
use_cases.description: Turn a topic and goal into a 30 to 45 second script with a hook, payoff, loop, and long-form CTA.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Flopping Short
use_cases.description: Review VVSA, retention, and Engaged Views to find why a Short stalled and which beats to rewrite.

use_cases.title: Build a Shorts Funnel
use_cases.description: Map Shorts to matching long-form videos with pinned comments, final-frame labels, and channel page checks.

prompt_templates.title: Write My First Short
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a 30 to 45 second YouTube Short about [topic] for [audience]. Include a hook, spoken lines, on-screen text, payoff, loop, and long-form CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Weak Opening
prompt_templates.prompt: My Short has [VVSA] and the first 3 seconds show [opening]. Diagnose the opening and rewrite it with a stronger visual hook and first line.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Long-Form Bridge
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a Short about [topic] and a long-form video titled [title]. Write the callout, pinned comment, final-frame label, and tracking plan.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Shorts Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Shorts plan for [channel niche]: [planned Shorts], [long-form library], [metrics], [constraints]. Prioritize retention, Shorts tab consistency, monetization, and next uploads.

output_examples.input: Topic: three mistakes people make when cleaning cast iron.
output_examples.output: A concise Shorts outline with first-frame visual, hook line, escalation beats, payoff, loop design, and a specific long-form callout.

output_examples.input: Metrics: VVSA 52%, average viewed 38%, and a drop in the first 2 seconds.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: the opening failed the swipe gate. The rewrite starts on the result, removes intro time, and moves the payoff earlier.

output_examples.input: Goal: connect a skincare Short to a 12-minute routine video.
output_examples.output: A bridge package with spoken CTA, pinned comment, final-frame label, and post-upload metrics to check after 72 hours.

best_practices: Give the skill real metrics when diagnosing: VVSA, average percentage viewed, retention shape, and Engaged Views.
Provide the exact long-form title when asking for a bridge.
Use the output as a draft, then test it against real Studio results.
anti_patterns: Asking it to guarantee viral performance or exact revenue.
Using it without a clear audience, topic, or upload goal.
Copying the script directly without checking brand rules, rights, captions, and platform format.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a Short will go viral?
faq.answer: No. It gives pattern-based guidance and testing criteria, but reach depends on audience behavior and platform distribution.

faq.question: Does it need my YouTube Studio analytics?
faq.answer: For diagnosis, yes. VVSA, retention shape, average percentage viewed, and Engaged Views make the recommendations more specific.

faq.question: Can it write Shorts for any niche?
faq.answer: Yes, if you provide the topic, audience, goal, and constraints. It does not bring live niche data by itself.

faq.question: Does it create the video file?
faq.answer: No. It creates scripts, checks, and funnel copy. You still need to film, edit, caption, and upload the Short.

faq.question: How does it handle monetization?
faq.answer: It explains Engaged Views, music splits, RPM expectations, and YPP paths so creators can choose reach or revenue goals.

faq.question: Can I use it in Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
